name: cmu-re-gui-ws-fix
author: CMU-Revised
description: The stock HMI message handler calls _isStack and _delStack as methods, but they are plain functions, so every call throws a TypeError into the log. This makes them methods of Websockets. Uninstall and restart to get the stock behaviour back.

files.reason: _isStack and _delStack become Websockets methods, so the calls stop throwing a TypeError into the log
